يختلبون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَلِبُونَ (yaḵtalibūna) /jax.ta.li.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# يُخْتَلَبُونَ (yuḵtalabūna) /jux.ta.la.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
